answer: Weight is earned on probation, not at registration: a new seat has its first verdicts re-checked by two established peers. Only sustained accuracy raises its sampling chance, so a fresh identity holds almost no influence however many are minted. A farm must judge honestly for epochs before it counts, and one careless stretch drains more weight than farming adds. Cloned keys buy a wide but shallow lagoon: many seats, no depth. Real influence behaves like a karst aquifer, filling by seepage, not one downpour. Peers trust a steady pulse of correct calls, not a big registry.
